metadata.description: atebites-hub plugin catalog: open-dynamic-workflows, ponytail, Advisor (sol-advisor), taskboard, j-space, and llm-as-a-verifier. All sources are in-repo paths so Cursor Import from Repo can index them.

plugins.name: open-dynamic-workflows
plugins.description: Dynamic workflow orchestration — workflow MCP tool, authoring skill, and /workflows command.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: sol-advisor
plugins.description: Advisor skills, slash commands, and doctor. Strict delegation stays disabled until runtime evidence matches the Advisor contract.

plugins.name: taskboard
plugins.description: Per-repo Taskboard coordination: sprint tickets, local SQLite board, and the taskboard-workflow skill.

plugins.name: j-space
plugins.description: Inference-time workspace control for long-horizon work: selective loading, ledger at seams, named verification, and recovery.

plugins.name: llm-as-a-verifier
plugins.description: Wrapped skill+MCP for high-stakes ODW / best-of-N logprob verification. Not an upstream Cursor plugin; not Advisor evidence.
